title: Depth-normalized order-flow imbalance
mechanism_formula: At the touch dP ≈ OFI/(Q_bid+Q_ask+eps); trades and cancellations both deplete a queue. Feed depth-normalized signed net queue change to the price-level head, not only the last trade.
regime_boundary: Helps when equal net flow moves price differently at different depths; adds noise if depth is near constant or flow is already priced.
numerical_guardrails: eps>0 or log-depth; finite and signed under empty queues; no future quotes.

title: Permanent versus transient response
citation: Bouchaud et al. (2009), https://arxiv.org/abs/0809.0822; Jusselin & Rosenbaum (2018), https://arxiv.org/html/1805.07134v1
mechanism_formula: Slow baseline p plus transient depletion q_t = exp(-gamma*dt)*q_prev + u(e_t), read out additively, so response decays after trading stops without erasing persistent price discovery.
regime_boundary: Plausible when temporary response is followed by replenishment; harmful if responses are genuinely persistent or recovery already fits.
numerical_guardrails: gamma=softplus(theta)>0, dt>=0; independent additive gates, not a competitive softmax.

title: Multiscale order-flow memory
mechanism_formula: Order splitting gives sign autocorrelation C(lag) ~ lag^(-alpha); approximate by sum_m w_m*r_m^lag over geometric retention scales, optionally clocked by normalized volume v/mean_v.
regime_boundary: Useful when persistence spans many lags and the model misses it; with weak persistence slow modes keep stale history and hurt event fit. No impact guarantee.
numerical_guardrails: r_m in (0.5, 0.995); bounded volume clock; stable causal affine updates within the shared state budget.

title: Queue-reactive conditional intensity
mechanism_formula: Addition, cancellation and market-order rates may depend nonlinearly on Q(side, level). Read local queue features, gate replenishment near an empty touch, and feed level-indexed state to the event and size heads.
regime_boundary: Strongest when depletion and repair are frequent and rollouts exhaust; with stable liquidity extra state wastes capacity or distorts rates.
numerical_guardrails: Keep event legality and the state budget; bounded transforms of tiny depths; never fabricate quotes.

title: Price-coordinate advection
mechanism_formula: A resting queue changes relative level when the best quote moves. Keep a [B,10,d] state and shift each side by its observed displacement dk before updating: S_t[level] uses S_prev[level±dk].
regime_boundary: Useful when best quotes move often and level states misregister; adds complexity without benefit when coordinates rarely move. Matrix state alone is not advection.
numerical_guardrails: Clip dk to [-10,10]; learned bounded fill for entering slots; count stored price scalars; step/sequence equivalence.

title: Multichannel self-exciting intensity
mechanism_formula: Per event type, lambda_t = mu + A*(lambda_prev*exp(-beta*dt_prev)) + B*phi(e_prev); feed a finite positive transform to the waiting-time and event heads (self- and cross-excitation).
regime_boundary: Plausible when arrivals are bursty beyond a constant-rate process; under nearly independent constant-rate arrivals it fits noise. Require a time-head gain.
numerical_guardrails: beta>0; bounded nonnegative intensity; subcritical excitation (spectral radius <1); stable at zero wait.

title: Imbalance-dependent microprice
citation: Dayri & Rosenbaum (2015), https://arxiv.org/html/1207.6325v2; Pulido et al. (2024), https://arxiv.org/pdf/2307.15599
mechanism_formula: At a one-tick spread, imbalance I=(Qb-Qa)/(Qb+Qa+eps) can locate an implied efficient price; feed a bounded odd g(I, spread) to the price head.
regime_boundary: Useful when a narrow spread hides pressure that predicts quote moves; misleading if imbalance is noise or wide-spread moves dominate.
numerical_guardrails: I in [-1,1], g(-I,s) = -g(I,s); no future quotes or zero denominator.

title: Prediction innovation filter
mechanism_formula: Expected continuation should not accumulate permanent displacement: forecast phi_hat(h_prev), take innovation nu_t = phi(e_t) - phi_hat, update h_t = A*h_prev + K_t*nu_t instead of raw imbalance.
regime_boundary: Helps if directions are predictable and the model overreacts to expected flow; suppresses real signal if flow is unpredictable or state already learns innovation.
numerical_guardrails: K_t = sigmoid(gate), initial bias -2; predict before the event; stable A; causal step equivalence.

title: Bid-ask reflection symmetry
mechanism_formula: Reflection P swaps bid/ask queues and flips signed event and price coordinates; mirrored shared encoders with the matching output permutation give f(P*x) = P_out*f(x) up to a modest bias.
regime_boundary: Useful if free-path drift or side asymmetry is spurious; hard tying erases real persistent side asymmetry, so keep a bounded residual.
numerical_guardrails: Check event, level and size labels under reflection; keep causal state and legal masks.

title: Selective delta erase and route
citation: Yang et al. (2024), https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.06484; ASI-Arch (2026), https://arxiv.org/html/2507.18074v2
mechanism_formula: A scalar forget gate erases useful state together with obsolete state. Matrix state S_t = S_prev*(I - beta*k*k^T) + beta*v*k^T rewrites only the keyed direction; a positive floor keeps other routes alive.
regime_boundary: Helps if sparse quote changes invalidate part of history while other signals persist; wasteful when all state should reset or nothing changes locally.
numerical_guardrails: L2-normalize k; beta in (0,1); other routes floored at >=0.05; count all state scalars.
